title: Investigation of the relationship between frailty and balance parameters in older patients in the perioperative setting: deviation of body sway
summary:
The aim of the study is to investigate the relationship between pre-existing age- and/or disease-related limitations and easily recordable balance parameters. 
We also want to find out what influence anesthesia has on these balance parameters, how they change immediately after an operation and whether this can indicate an increased risk of falling. The aim is to be able to take targeted measures to prevent falls together with physiotherapists in the future.

interventions.name: Patients aged ≥ 70 years without gender prefernce should be included in the study. Recruitment takes place during the preoperative phase as an inpatient or outpatient as part of a planned medical procedure with anesthesia at UKSH Campus Lübeck. criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Planned surgical intervention with anesthesia procedure 
- Inpatient admission
- Sufficient cognitive competence to understand information, process questions and provide answers regarding own medical history and planned procedure
Exclusion criteria:
- Acute immobilizing trauma or acute debilitating illness
- Insufficient knowledge of German with severely impaired communication
- Blindness, severe visual impairment that is not corrected by a visual aid
- very urgent indication for surgery (within 0 to 12 hours, N0-N3)
- Lack of written consent to participate
- Insufficient standing ability (without aids) of the patient 
- Body weight > 150kg
